notes.title: UPDATE 0.4 is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354624/ea7c2c1f4052141d77c17e5caa522e0e7e67ab88.gif[/img]

[b] Hi, everyone! [/b]

Welcome to Update 0.4! As we are getting closer to leaving the Early Access, we prioritize finding solutions for issues that have been bothering you and us for some time. We are planning to make some technical in-between updates for the Free-to-Play stage, and this is just one of them. 
On top of that, we’ve studied and analyzed a lot of ranked races data and made several necessary tweaks. Plus, we’ve somewhat improved game stability and will keep improving it in the next few patches. We want to make sure that everything runs smoothly and works perfectly fine.

Get your hands on this update, GLHF!

Below you’ll find a detailed list of changes for update 0.4: 

[h1] Ranked Races changes [/h1]

As a part of pre-F2P preparations, we want to make the Ranked system more friendly to newcomers and more forgiving to players who deal with consecutive losses. Plus, we want to encourage players who reach certain leagues to move forward without worrying about a possible demotion. 
[list]
[*] Ranked Races are now available for queueing 24/7
[*] Numbers of gained and lost ranked points changed from -20/-10/10/20 to -100/-50/50/100 respectively.
[*] League caps increased from 1000 points necessary to promote to 2000 points.
[*] Negative points multiplier for taking 3d or 4th place for several times in a row removed.
[*] Positive points multiplier is now limited to x2 and is applied after taking 1st or 2d place for two times in a row.
[*] All Titan Leagues, Platinum 3 League, Diamond 3 League, and Master League are now “safe”. Players can no longer be demoted to the lower League.
[*] Network code algorithms for the Ranked matchmaking updated.
[/list]
[h1] Player’s Profile [/h1]

A profile page is something we wanted to implement for a long time. Tracking your stats and being able to affect them is something that helps players to raise their driving skills and set and achieve goals during gameplay. We’ll keep our attention on this feature, and will certainly add some new stats based on your suggestions and our observations.
[list]
[*] Profile page added to the garage. You can click on the Avatar to open it.
[*] You may observe other players profiles by clicking on their names in the Leaderboards.
[*] New fancy avatars added as possible crate drops.
[*] Avatars are now changeable. You may select any other obtained avatar from your profile page.
[/list]
[h1] Other stuff [/h1]
[list]
[*] [i] Gain X Drift points [/i] objectives for FWD cars removed. 
[*] New item type, that can be used for any tier but only once added. Upon equipping this item will be bound to the selected tier.
[*] Buyable Pro Crate and Pro Crate bundles added to the Crates menu.
[*] A number of fixes and tweaks performed to increase the client’s stability. The work’s not over, though, we are planning to push some more fixes in upcoming patches. 
[/list]

Stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.3 is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354624/3b0a1e62d1b752accfe055d248ff305ec22ff068.png[/img]

[b]Hi, everyone! [/b]

Here’s the third major Update for the World of Speed! We worked hard to get it ready as soon as possible and now we are happy to say it’s available at last. New features, challenges, balance adjustments, bug fixes and several UI improvements are here for you to try them out.

[b]Below you can find a detailed list of changes for update 0.3: [/b]

[h1]Daily Challenges Feature [/h1]

We introduced a new fancy way of obtaining items, credits and dealer points! We’ve been working on the concept of Daily Challenges for quite some time, trying to fit this feature into the game. We tried various approaches and finally decided on this. Actually, there are four “ways” or types of available challenges for you to complete. These are:
[list]
[*]Beginner’s challenge - must be the easiest one. It consists of three quests, but you have to be quick to complete it, as it re-rolls every hour, each time with different rewards! Upon completing this challenge you’ll be rewarded with a common car part.

[*]Driver’s challenge - a little bit harder than Beginner’s, consists of four quests, final reward is a Polished brand new item. You have an hour and a half to complete it!

[*]Racer’s challenge - a set of five quests with harder objectives, goals and a guaranteed Special quality item as a reward. Three hours to complete and the item is yours!

[*]Master’s challenge - this one is quite special. You have a set of seven quests and 24 hours to complete each one of them. If you complete a quest earlier, the next one won’t appear until the timer goes off, so this challenge will require a week to complete. But it will surely be worth your while. Each subsequent pair of quests has better rewards than the previous one, and the last quest will bring you an Advanced rarity item! Don’t miss your rewards!
[/list]
"Challenges" icon has been added to the left side of the garage screen. Watch the indicator for the available Challenges! 

[h1]Item Reassemble[/h1]

Another awesome feature we are introducing in this update is making higher quality items out of those you already have. If you have some duplicates or items you just don’t need, you can now make use of them. Take four items of the same quality and fuse them into a better one! 

“Rebuild” button has been added to the lower side of the inventory space. Forge with care! 

[h1]Balance tweaks[/h1]

More balance tweaks await you in this Update. Every car stats have been revised, as well as top speed and acceleration specifications. We’ve reduced the power of several “must have” cars and buffed some “outsiders” for the sake of making the game more diverse and competitive. We’ll continue to monitor the in-game balance and we will be happy to get some feedback.

We are already working on the next update, so stay tuned for the upcoming Dev Blogs and community posts!

See you on the road, fellow racers!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354624/48bf3cdf725e7094657bdd3239dc045f62cf7bc6.gif[/img]

[b]Hi, fellow racers![/b]

We are very happy to announce that our second major update is here and ready for you to try! This update brings massive improvements to upgrade system, significant balance tweaks and lots of new features, not to mention quite a number of smaller bug fixes.c More updates are coming soon and the next one is already in the works.

Below you can find a detailed list of changes for update 0.2:

[b]Upgrade System revamp[/b]

We’ve completely reworked car upgrade systems to make it more flexible and variative. From now on you can enhance your car by upgrading five different systems and unlocking slots designated for special items which can be obtained from reward crates. Different setups and equipped items make each car special, so no race will ever be the same.
It’s up to you to decide what are you going to max out first! 

[b]Cars rebalancing[/b]

As the upgrades were completely overhauled, every car underwent stats revision and multiple balance adjustments. 

[b]Progression system revision[/b]

Due to the Upgrade System changes the whole progression system had been revised, which resulted in the following:
[list]
[*]Race rewards now fit the tier of the vehicle that is used in the race. That includes credits, experience and dealer points.
[*]The amount of experience needed to advance to the next level is revised for every stage of the game.
[*]End of the season rating rewards are now even more valuable! Instead of flat amount of credits contestants will receive a set of crates, unique for each league.
[/list]
[b]Crates added as race rewards[/b]

Another important change, coming with this update, is the implementation of the Reward Crates. It is now possible to get them as race rewards and find valuable loot inside, which includes:
[list]
[*]Different car parts that can be used to enhance your car’s performance.
[*]Boosters temporarily increasing the gain of credits, experience and dealer [*]points by a certain percent.
[*]And other rewards, like credits, dealer points and even diamonds!
[/list]
Plus, we’ve put some effort in client optimization, making game booting much quicker and solving several crushing issues.

Specific tires were temporarily disabled, but will return in one of the next updates, as we need some time to adjust them to the new balance and solve several issues with their influence on bet points.

[b]...And a great amount of code improvements and bug fixes![/b]

Have a nice time playing World of Speed and stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 0.1 is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354624/fbe6e82c3b6f918d70a10875fca22d1d0f8a06de.gif[/img]

[b]Hello, everyone![/b]

We are glad to announce that World of Speed Update 0.1 is now live!  It features new Ranked Race game mode, new London racing tracks, a brand new dealer with top-notch new supercars, improved external controllers support and of course - tons of bug fixes and smaller enhancements. 
Also, we would like to specifically emphasize this update is just one of the many we are planning for the future, all of which would be released on a regular basis.

Below you can find a detailed list of changes for the 0.1 update.

[b]New game mode for experienced players - Ranked Races*:[/b]
[list][*]Compete for rank 
[*]Track your rating in the global leaderboard
[*]Get promoted to more prestigious leagues
[*]Win prizes in the end of every season
[*]Become the Grandmaster - absolute champion of World of Speed[/list]
[i]*Please note that the Ranked Races are now in alpha testing, thus they are available only from 5PM to 7PM UTC.[/i]

[b]Brand new car dealer - "Ultimate Power", which opens access to "I" tier vehicles:[/b]
[list][*]Pagani Huayra - the car with greatest maximal speed
[*]McLaren MP4-12C - the car with the greatest acceleration rate[/list]
[b]London - new location featuring new racing tracks:[/b]
[list][*]Trafalgar Chicane - perfectly balanced mix of straight sectors and sharp turns
[*]Palace - long straight sectors to embrace top speed, few sharp turns to win advantage over clumsies
[*]Westminster - a paradise of sharp turns without straight sectors long enough to reach top speed
[*]St. James Loop - a lot of shortcut options, long straight sectors and really mean turns[/List]
[b]Improved support for gaming controllers:[/b]
[List][*]The number of supported gaming devices is extended*
[*]Reworked controller input processing logic  
[*]Advanced options for controllers setup added[/List]
[i]*Even more devices will be supported in future updates[/i]

[b]Readjusted balance for a number of cars:[/b]
[List][*]Ford Focus: increased upgrade bonuses for maneuverability, top speed and acceleration
[*]Toyota GT86: decreased upgrade bonuses for top speed and acceleration
[*]Subaru BRZ: decreased upgrade bonuses for top speed and acceleration
[*]Nissan 200SX: decreased upgrade bonus for top speed
[*]Mazda RX7: increased upgrade bonuses for acceleration, decreased bonus for top speed
[*]Mini Cooper S: increased upgrade bonus for maneuverability[/List]

Have a nice time playing and see you in the World of Speed!

notes.title: News: upcoming update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354624/82fe5af2b4989b7cadff6733e35d4ff366cc2f8c.gif[/img]

[b]Hello everyone![/b]

It is time to share some information about new features that will be added in the following update of World of Speed.

[b]Ranked races[/b]

The most important addition is the Ranked Race mode that will allow players to compete with each other for the top position at the global rating, composed of ten different leagues. In each ranked race you will face several selected opponents among other players and the usual rewards will be achieved along with special Rating Points. By accumulating these points you will be able to gain access to more prestigious leagues, compete with stronger players, hone and prove your skills so you can fight for the better positions to get bigger season rewards.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354624/27dbc540153bb8cb49c63b1d360967b9274df392.gif[/img]

[b]Racing wheels and gamepads[/b]

At the time of the Early Access the range of game controllers supported by the game without any errors was quite scarce. Initially this problem was due to a number of technical restrictions inherited by the past game , which required significant modifications to the program code. We are actively working on a solution of this problem and will gradually increase the number of devices supported to the maximum. By the moment the update is  released, players will find the range of devices expanded and to return to the game using familiar racing wheels and gamepads.

[b]New cars - Ultimate Power[/b]

The update will include a new dealer - Ultimate Power. It will add two new supercars of the top “I” tier, which are famous among all fans of powerful vehicles – the Pagani Huayra and McLaren 12C. In World of Speed these cars will set a new higher bar for speed and controllability. However, only the most experienced players will be able to truly exploit their potential as the higher speeds demand perfect skills and reaction times. Those who are capable of maneuvering the advanced difficulty of these cars will have the opportunity to achieve superb results on the tracks which in turn has the greatest importance to ranked races.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354624/3b07742f63a8e72b17aeab0a21792ab1afa18b64.jpg[/img]

[b]At Queen Elizabeth’s[/b]

Especially for British architecture connoisseurs we have added four new London race tracks that can provide a worthy challenge for experienced racers longing to show off their skills. Perhaps you are keen on drifts? Then welcome to Westminster, where the longest part of the track takes mere seconds to pass. Or maybe your party piece is detour alleys? St. James Loop will display a great number of alternative routes. And last but not least – the Palace and Trafalgar Chicane will satisfy the needs of high speed and drag lovers as they will be given a free hand to get the most from their cars.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354624/1e6bca912b400a04e4912c61b0253a7fb53dc9a2.jpg[/img]

[b]Car balance improved[/b]

The October update will come with improved car balance. Right now not all cars in the game receive the correct bonuses from the upgrades. That is why a lot of rear drive vehicles show better results than the front drive ones. A striking example of that is the Subaru BRZ, which is much more efficient than not only the Abarth 500, but even the Mini Cooper whose tier level is obviously higher. The new balance system will increase the efficiency of front drive cars as well as fix their upgrade values. These changes will make the game more fair, and the process of progressing – more entertaining and ultimately – increase the diversity of cars participating in races.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354624/2d5da8a2de6adc2582d0a723934774d502a80dc1.png[/img]

[b]Bug fixes and corrections[/b]

Along with these huge additions, we continue working on less visible, but still significant features. That is – fixes of various bugs and cosmetic corrections, which will be present in the update. Also we would like to thank all the players who help us by reporting bugs and errors discovered in the game. We keep a sharp eye out for your feedback and thanks to it, we were able to fix a range of bugs that were difficult to reproduce. Thank you!

[b]When?[/b]

And of course the key question – when will all the changes be available for the players? Our team is working hard to complete all necessary tasks and QA checks and will add new features as soon as possible. According to our current plan, the update will be released by the end of this month.
